title: IPC admin.peers.add_address and admin.peers.remove_address result
description: What an add or a removal did (ADR-0062). A REFUSAL IS AN ANSWER, not an error: `outcome: refused` names its rule in `refused`, a closed set a client renders in its own words, and nothing was written. `detail` is for a log, never parsed. `unchanged` is an add of an address already present, authored or added, or a removal of one the overlay does not hold; a removal of an authored one is refused `authored`. A write that fails is the error `Internal`, nothing changed (written before published, ADR-0028).

refused.$comment: Present exactly when outcome is refused. grammar: not a multiaddr-with-peer-id. own_peer: an add of an address whose PeerId is this node's own (from minor 2.9; below it the same add is refused grammar). special_use: a component of a refused class of ADR-0052 rule 2 (loopback, link-local, unspecified, multicast or another special-use range; private ranges are admitted). bound: authored and added entries would exceed 64. provider_disabled: the profile authors the static-bootstrap provider enabled: false (an add only). authored: the address is config.yaml's (a removal only).
